title: File reference
description: A reference to one file a record depends on and does not embed: where the file is, its SHA-256 digest, its media type and, optionally, its size, its format and the proof of where it came from. A reader fetches the file at uri and checks it against sha256.

uri.description: Where the file can be fetched.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the file's bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

contentType.description: The file's IANA media type, as an Asset Administration Shell File element's contentType carries it.

format.description: The file format and version beyond what the media type says. Known values: dstv-nc-8.0, dstv-xnc-9.0, dstv-xas, ifc-4.3, aasx, ids-1.0.

provenance.description: Proof of where the file came from and that it is unchanged since.
